title: Slay the Spire 2
provenance: Reported by hamza-sahin (highball-db#84, 2026-09-16), Apple M2 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.9.19, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r3, rated 5 of 5 after 271 minutes. Graphics mode not stated. Not verified by the maintainer. RIMACODING (highball-db#988, 2026-11-04), Apple M5, macOS 26.7.1, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXVK by the report (the environment's mode is DXMT), rated 3 of 5 after 75 minutes: Slay the Spire 2 version 107, a Godot 4 game, at a steady frame time once three fixes were in place, all the reporter's own. Godot's default Direct3D 12 renderer showed a green screen with sound on D3DMetal, which the reporter puts down to IDXGIFactory2::CreateSwapChainForComposition, so an override.cfg in the game's folder sets rendering_device/driver="vulkan" to use Vulkan through MoltenVK. Multiplayer proxy DLLs needed winmm=n,b. Online lobbies needed the Windows Steam client running in the environment, with sync off.
notes: This game has a native macOS version on Steam, so the Mac Steam app runs it directly without Highball. The Windows build was reported perfect through Highball over a four and a half hour session on an M2 Pro, mode not stated. A player on an M5 with version 107 needed three fixes of their own, listed below (highball-db#988). No measurement here yet.

knownIssues.symptom: A green screen with sound at start on D3DMetal (Godot's Direct3D 12 renderer)
knownIssues.cause: by the reporter, Godot's Direct3D 12 renderer calls IDXGIFactory2::CreateSwapChainForComposition, which D3DMetal doesn't support
knownIssues.fix: put an override.cfg in the game's folder that sets rendering_device/driver="vulkan", so the game uses Vulkan through MoltenVK (highball-db#988)

knownIssues.cause: by the reporter, the multiplayer proxy DLL in the game's folder is a winmm.dll, and Wine uses its own winmm unless told otherwise
knownIssues.fix: add winmm=n,b in the environment's DLL overrides (highball-db#988)

knownIssues.symptom: Online lobbies don't work when the game isn't started through the Windows Steam client
knownIssues.cause: the game's Steamworks can't reach the Mac's Steam app, only a Windows Steam client running in the same environment
knownIssues.fix: start it with Play in Highball, which goes through the Windows Steam client in the environment. The reporter also turned sync off (highball-db#988)
